title: Persist an ExecutionAttempt record with a per-task generation counter
description:
Objective: give every execution of a task a durable identity, so a later call can be told whether it belongs to the current attempt or a superseded one. This is the foundation the rest of the epic fences on.

Deliverable: an ExecutionAttempt type in packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts and a new packages/moe-daemon/src/state/attemptStore.ts holding it, persisted under .moe/attempts/. Fields: id, taskId, workerId, runnerId, generation (monotonic per task, starting at 1), workspace, phase (running, finalizing, reconciling, closed), startedAt, lastPhaseAt, and optional process start time and host for later reattachment. Copy the durable-first ordering already proven in state/resourceStore.ts: write the record before the state transition it enables, and make a second pass repair a partial write rather than duplicating it.

Not in scope: wiring into claim, complete or release; any tool registration; any client change. Those are separate sibling tasks. This task adds the record and its store only.

Verification: npx vitest run src/state/attemptStore.test.ts from packages/moe-daemon.
definitionOfDone: ExecutionAttempt is declared in packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts with the phase union running, finalizing, reconciling, closed
packages/moe-daemon/src/state/attemptStore.ts creates, reads, updates the phase of and lists attempts, persisting one JSON file per attempt under .moe/attempts/
openAttempt allocates a generation that is strictly greater than every prior attempt for that task, proven by a test opening three attempts in sequence
A new attempt written while a prior attempt for the same task is still running is rejected with a named error rather than silently overwriting it
Re-running the write path over a half-written record repairs it instead of creating a duplicate, proven by a durability test in the style of resourceStore.durability.test.ts
npx vitest run src/state/attemptStore.test.ts passes and npm test in packages/moe-daemon stays green
taskRails: Store layer only: no tool registration in tools/index.ts and no change to claim, complete or release handlers.
Follow the persist-before-transition ordering in state/resourceStore.ts; do not invent a second persistence idiom.
